# e2e/.auth/ — Playwright saved auth state directory
# JSON files here are generated by auth.setup.ts at runtime.
# They contain session tokens — NEVER commit them to git.
#
# To generate:
#   1. Copy .env.test.example → .env.test and fill in TEST_SHOP_PHONE etc.
#   2. Run: npm run e2e:setup
#   3. Then run: npm run e2e
